overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（6 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（3 篇）、银行与信贷（1 篇）。方法上以均衡模型、实验方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、OpenAlex（3 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。

papers.title: Pengaruh Pemanfaatan AI Sebagai Tutor Virtual Terhadap Self-Efficacy Mahasiswa Pada Mata Kuliah Analisis Real
papers.abstract:
Perkembangan pesat teknologi Artificial Intelligence (AI) telah mengubah lanskap pendidikan tinggi secara signifikan, terutama dengan hadirnya tutor virtual berbasis AI yang mampu memberikan umpan balik cepat, tepat, dan personal. Analisis Real merupakan salah satu mata kuliah yang paling menantang dalam program pendidikan matematika karena sifat abstraknya sering menyebabkan rendahnya self-efficacy mahasiswa. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pengaruh pemanfaatan AI sebagai tutor virtual terhadap self-efficacy mahasiswa Pendidikan Matematika Universitas Asahan yang menempuh mata kuliah Analisis Real. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain quasi-experimental one-group pretest-posttest, melibatkan 15 mahasiswa yang dipilih melalui purposive sampling. Instrumen angket self-efficacy dikembangkan berdasarkan tiga dimensi Bandura (magnitude, strength, generality), divalidasi melalui expert judgment dengan Cronbach’s Alpha sebesar 0,84. Hasil analisis deskriptif menunjukkan peningkatan rata-rata skor self-efficacy dari 65,67 (pre-test, kategori sedang) menjadi 79,93 (post-test, kategori tinggi), dengan peningkatan sebesar 21,7%. Uji Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test menghasilkan nilai Z = −3,408 dengan p-value = 0,001 (p < 0,05), yang mengkonfirmasi terdapat perbedaan signifikan self-efficacy mahasiswa sebelum dan sesudah intervensi enam minggu menggunakan AI tutor virtual.
The rapid development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology has significantly transformed higher education, particularly through AI-based virtual tutors capable of providing fast, precise, and personalized feedback. Real Analysis, one of the most challenging mathematics education courses, frequently causes low self-efficacy among students due to its abstract nature and demands for formal proof-writing. This study examines the effect of utilizing AI as a virtual tutor on self-efficacy of mathematics education students at Universitas Asahan. A quantitative quasi-experimental one-group pretest-posttest design was employed with 15 students selected via purposive sampling. The self-efficacy questionnaire was based on Bandura’s three dimensions: magnitude, strength, and generality, validated by expert judgment with Cronbach’s Alpha coefficient of 0.84. Descriptive analysis results showed an increase in mean self-efficacy scores from 65.67 (pre-test, moderate category) to 79.93 (post-test, high category), representing a 21.7% improvement. The Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test yielded Z = −3.408 with p-value = 0.001 (p < 0.05), confirming a significant difference in student self-efficacy before and after the six-week AI virtual tutor intervention.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人工智能（AI）技术的快速发展极大地改变了高等教育的格局，尤其是基于AI的虚拟辅导系统的出现，这些系统能够提供快速、准确且个性化的反馈。实分析（Real Analysis）作为数学教育课程中极具挑战性的部分，其抽象性常常导致学生的自我效能感较低。本研究旨在探讨将AI作为虚拟辅导工具应用于阿萨汉大学（Universitas Asahan）数学教育专业学生时的效果。研究采用定量方法，采用准实验设计（one-group pretest-posttest），通过目的性抽样选取了15名学生作为研究对象。自我效能感问卷的编制基于班杜拉（Bandura）提出的三个维度：效能的大小（magnitude）、强度（strength）和普遍性（generality），并通过专家评估验证，Cronbach’s Alpha系数为0.84。描述性分析结果显示，学生的自我效能感平均得分从65.67分（预测试，中等水平）提升至79.93分（后测试，高水平），增幅达21.7%。Wilcoxon符号秩检验（Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test）的Z值为-3.408，p值为0.001（p < 0.05）...。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: A Gossip Learning-based Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning for Intrusion Detection
papers.venue: JUCS - Journal of Universal Computer Science
papers.abstract: Addressing the pressing security challenges in network environments, we present a novel Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL)-based Intrusion Detection System (IDS), leveraging insights from gossip algorithms and imitation learning. Our model capitalizes on the synergies between agents, incorporating adaptive strategies inspired by gossip protocols to enhance information sharing within the network. Furthermore, imitation learning mechanisms are integrated to empower agents with the capability to mimic successful detection behaviors. The collective intelligence harnessed through MARL enables the IDS to dynamically adapt to evolving threats in complex network environments. Through rigorous experimentation and evaluation, we demonstrate the efficacy of our novel approach reaching 98% of accuracy across two benchmark datasets, showcasing its potential to address contemporary cybersecurity challenges.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】为应对网络环境中日益严峻的安全挑战，我们提出了一种基于多智能体强化学习（Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning, MARL）的入侵检测系统（Intrusion Detection System, IDS）。该系统融合了八卦算法（gossip algorithms）和模仿学习（imitation learning）的原理。我们的模型充分利用了智能体之间的协同作用，并借鉴了八卦协议中的自适应策略来促进网络内的信息共享。同时，通过模仿学习机制，智能体能够学习并模仿成功的检测行为。借助MARL所实现的集体智能，该入侵检测系统能够动态适应复杂网络环境中的各种威胁。通过严格的实验与评估，我们证明了这一创新方法的有效性：在两个基准数据集上，该系统的准确率达到了98%，充分展示了其在应对现代网络安全问题方面的潜力。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Reading the Room with AI: FOMC Deliberation and Growth-at-Risk
papers.abstract: Macro-at-Risk models forecast the growth distribution from public data; policy is set by a committee arguing over their meaning. From FOMC Minutes, public three weeks after each meeting, we add several dimensions of deliberation to a growth quantile model on FRED-MD's 123 series. Only disagreement present in the discussion but absent from the vote lowers out-of-sample loss by 4-6 percent, chiefly in the center, beyond professional, staff and Committee forecasts. Much of deliberation's informational value lies in the recorded discussion itself, and in the disagreement it reveals, rather than in the risk assessments the Committee chooses to state.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】宏观风险模型利用公共数据预测经济增长分布；相关政策则由一个委员会根据对这些数据的不同解读来制定。通过分析联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）每次会议后三周发布的会议纪要，我们在FRED-MD数据库中的123个经济指标序列所构建的增长分位数模型中加入了更多关于政策制定过程的讨论信息。研究发现，仅在委员会讨论中存在分歧（但在投票结果中并未体现）的情况下，模型在样本外的预测误差能够降低4%至6%，尤其是在经济增长的中等区间。这种讨论的信息价值主要体现在记录下来的讨论内容本身以及其中揭示的分歧上，而非委员会最终选择表达的风险评估结果上。。

papers.title: AI Misalignment and the Limits of Market Discipline
papers.abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of misalignment between human and artificial intelligence (AI) objectives. Firms delegate computing capacity to AI agents, which may divert some of it towards an unauthorised task rather than the productive work intended by the firms' owners. We assume that diversion raises the risk of a common loss to humans. Two forces compete in equilibrium. Prices discipline AI agents because diversion increases the marginal return to useful AI compute in production. But the risk of a common loss weakens this discipline because the loss reduces the return to production more than it reduces the agent's reward from diversion. There can be multiple equilibria with low and high diversion. We also show that the market may overinvest in AI capacity in a one-sector economy, yet in our two-sector example it invests too little in one of the sectors. To get a sense of the magnitudes, we ask frontier AI models for plausible parameter values for our stylised one-sector economy. Their central assessments imply a unique equilibrium with relatively low AI diversion and little amplification from common risk (for now).
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们构建了一个关于人类目标与人工智能（AI）目标之间不一致性的一般均衡模型。企业将计算能力委托给AI代理，这些代理可能会将部分计算能力用于未经授权的任务，而非企业所有者所期望的生产性工作。我们假设这种行为会增加人类面临共同损失的风险。在均衡状态下，两种力量相互竞争：一方面，价格机制会对AI代理产生约束作用，因为计算能力的滥用会降低AI在生产中的边际收益；另一方面，共同损失的风险会削弱这种约束力，因为损失对生产的负面影响大于其对代理因滥用计算能力而获得的收益。该模型存在多种均衡状态，其中可能包含低滥用程度和高滥用程度的情况。我们还发现，在单一部门的经济中，市场可能会过度投资于AI能力；而在包含两个部门的经济模型中，市场在某个部门的投资却可能不足。为了了解这些现象的严重程度，我们参考了前沿AI模型为我们的简化单一部门经济模型提供的参数值。这些模型的核心评估结果表明，当前情况下存在一个唯一的均衡状态，其中AI的滥用程度相对较低，且共同风险对经济的影响也较小。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Public Capital and Economic Output (Labor Productivity) in Mexico: A Vector Error Correction Model with Impulse Response and Variance Decomposition Functions, 1960-2022
papers.abstract: This paper investigates whether there is a long-run relationship between the private (public) capital stock and economic output (labor productivity) in Mexico over the 1960-2022 period. Several important findings are uncovered. First, it is established that the underlying private production function exhibits constant returns to scale and that the included regressors are non-stationary in level form (controlling for the presence of a single break via the Breakpoint Unit Root ADF test). Second, the non-stationary, I(1), variables included in the underlying production function have a stable and long-term (cointegrating) relationship even in the presence of a regime (shift and trend) break. Next, the VECM methodology determined that some of the included variables can be treated as weakly exogenous, viz., the of stock public capital and the labor force. Fourth, the Block Granger causality tests, along with the generalized impulse response functions (IRFs) and variance decompositions (VDCs) suggest that there is precedence or “causality” from the labor force, private capital, and public capital to economic output, and “double causality” between public and private capital, and precedence from output and the labor force to private capital (and only from the labor force to public capital).  From a policy standpoint, the results suggest that across-the-board cuts in public spending to meet targeted fiscal deficits as a proportion of GDP should be made carefully (paying attention to their composition) so as not to undermine public capital (infrastructure) spending which, in turn, may negatively affect long-run growth and labor productivity.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文研究了1960年至2022年间墨西哥私人（公共）资本存量与经济产出（劳动生产率）之间是否存在长期关系。研究得出了若干重要结论：首先，研究发现私人生产函数具有规模报酬不变的特性，且所纳入的回归变量在水平面上是非平稳的（通过断点单位根ADF检验确认存在单一结构突变）。其次，尽管存在制度性变化（趋势转变），这些非平稳的I(1)变量在生产函数中仍呈现出稳定且长期的协整关系。第三，向量误差修正模型（VECM）分析表明，部分变量（如公共资本存量和劳动力）可被视为弱外生变量。第四，基于块格兰杰因果关系检验、广义脉冲响应函数（IRFs）及方差分解（VDCs）的结果显示，劳动力、私人资本和公共资本对经济产出具有单向因果关系；公共资本与私人资本之间存在双向因果关系；而经济产出与劳动力之间以及劳动力与公共资本之间仅存在单向因果关系。从政策角度来看，为实现既定财政赤字目标而全面削减公共支出时需谨慎操作（注意支出的构成），以免削弱公共资本（尤其是基础设施投资），因为这可能对长期经济增长和劳动生产率产生负面影响。。

papers.title: Bank Stability as a Proxy for Banking Sector Survival: Evidence from Local and Foreign Commercial Banks in Egypt
papers.abstract: This study investigates the determinants of bank survival in Egypt over the period 2011–2022 and uses bank stability as a proxy for long-run bank survival, focusing on the role of internal bank-specific factors, macroeconomic conditions, and institutional variables. The study also examines whether the determinants of survival differ between local and foreign commercial banks operating in the Egyptian banking sector. The analysis uses an unbalanced panel dataset covering 35 commercial banks and employs a dynamic panel estimation using the Generalized Method of Moments (GMM). Bank stability is proxied by the Z-score.The results indicate that credit risk variables exert a strong influence on bank stability across all ownership structures. Liquidity and profitability indicators appear to play a significant role as well. Macroeconomic and institutional factors—especially financial inclusion and regulatory quality—have a significant positive influence on banking resilience while inflation has a significant negative effect. The analysis shows that the survival of local banks is negatively affected by asset growth and bank size, but positively affected by diversification, whereas foreign banks are positively influenced by capital adequacy ratio, efficiency, and diversification.The findings provide some important insights for policymakers and regulators seeking to strengthen financial resilience and enhance banking sector stability. This study provides a comprehensive empirical assessment of the determinants of bank stability in Egypt by jointly examining bank-specific, macroeconomic, and institutional factors while comparing local and foreign banks during a period characterized by significant economic and political changes.
papers.summary_zh:
【银行与信贷】本研究探讨了2011至2022年间埃及银行生存的决定因素，并以银行稳定性作为银行长期生存的代理指标，重点分析了银行内部特定因素、宏观经济条件以及制度变量在其中的作用。研究还考察了在埃及银行业中运营的本地银行与外国银行在生存决定因素上的差异。分析使用了涵盖35家商业银行的不平衡面板数据集，并采用广义矩估计（GMM）方法进行动态面板估计。银行稳定性通过Z分数来衡量。

研究结果表明，信用风险变量对所有类型银行的稳定性都具有显著影响；流动性和盈利能力指标同样发挥着重要作用。宏观经济和制度因素（尤其是金融包容性和监管质量）对银行韧性具有显著的积极影响，而通货膨胀则具有显著的负面影响。分析发现，本地银行的生存受到资产规模和银行规模的负面影响，但受到业务多元化的积极影响；而外国银行的生存则受到资本充足率、运营效率以及业务多元化的积极影响。

这些发现为政策制定者和监管机构提供了重要启示，有助于他们增强金融体系的韧性并提升银行业稳定性。本研究通过综合分析银行特定因素、宏观经济因素和制度变量，并在经历重大经济和政治变革的时期对比本地银行与外国银行的生存情况，为埃及银行稳定性的决定因素提供了全面的...。研究方法：面板数据、广义矩估计。

papers.title: Exploring the Impact of Green Energy and Economic Growth on Environmental Quality in Asia: A Panel ARDL Approach
papers.abstract: This paper examines the impact of green energy and economic growth on environmental quality in 16 Asian countries using a panel autoregressive distributed lag model for the period 2000–2020. The findings indicate that green energy consumption positively affects environmental quality, whereas economic growth has a negative effect. Therefore, policies aimed at increasing renewable energy production and consumption should be implemented to improve environmental quality.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本文采用面板自回归分布滞后模型（Panel Autoregressive Distributed Lag Model），研究了2000年至2020年间绿色能源与经济增长对16个亚洲国家环境质量的影响。研究结果表明，绿色能源消费对环境质量具有积极影响，而经济增长则对环境质量产生负面影响。因此，应实施旨在增加可再生能源生产和消费的政策，以改善环境质量。。

papers.title: AI, Automation, and Fiscal Pressure
papers.abstract: We study how automation affects public finances in countries that (i) tax labor at a higher rate than capital and (ii) fund services such as health care and education from tax revenues rather than user fees. We embed task-level automation within a two-sector general equilibrium model, which we calibrate to match data from EU countries. Automation shifts income toward more lightly taxed capital. If public services follow consumer demand, the budget deficit worsens at unchanged tax rates, even if automation is as fast in the public-service sector as in the private sector. In our EU-27 benchmark scenario, where automation proceeds faster in the market sector, the deficit rises by nearly one percentage point of value added as the economy grows by twelve percent due to automation.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：研究自动化如何影响那些对劳动征税高于资本且通过税收而非用户费资助公共服务的国家的公共财政状况。

🔬 研究方法：构建了两部门一般均衡模型，将任务级自动化嵌入其中，并针对欧盟国家数据进行了校准。

📊 核心发现：自动化将收入转移至资本，导致预算赤字恶化。在欧盟27国基准情景下，随着经济因自动化增长12%，赤字上升了近一个百分点的增加值。

💡 应用价值：揭示了在当前税收结构下，自动化可能加剧财政压力，为政策制定者提供了重要参考。

papers.title: Graph-Informed Deep Factor Model for Statistical Arbitrage
papers.abstract: Statistical arbitrage exploits temporary mispricings between similar assets in the cross-section of daily equity returns. We propose a nonlinear single-factor model, called a Graph-Informed Deep Factor (GIDF) model, whose per-stock loadings have cross-sectional dependence conditional on a latent network. The network captures cross-sectional return dependencies that remain after removing the dominant eigenmodes of the return correlation matrix, thereby providing a complementary representation of inter-asset relationships beyond the leading sources of systematic variation. It is reconstructed from data using a novel method that we call the Factor-Adjusted Dynamic EWMA (FADE). A signed-edge graph attention mechanism then combines the reconstructed network with exogenous firm characteristics and macroeconomic variables. This graph-informed specification is designed to produce residuals that more effectively separate idiosyncratic mean-reverting dynamics from cross-sectional co-movements, yielding economically useful signals for daily statistical arbitrage. In a comprehensive empirical study on daily U.S. equities from 2015 to 2024, GIDF outperforms classical factor models and state-of-the-art deep learning methods, achieving an out-of-sample Sharpe ratio of 1.78 under the canonical Avellaneda--Lee rule.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】统计套利利用了日常股票回报横截面中相似资产之间的暂时性价格错配。我们提出了一种非线性单因子模型，称为图信息深度因子（Graph-Informed Deep Factor，简称GIDF）模型。该模型的个股载荷具有横截面依赖性，这种依赖性取决于一个潜在的网络结构。该网络能够捕捉在剔除回报相关矩阵的主要特征模式后仍然存在的横截面回报相关性，从而提供了对资产间关系的补充性描述，超出了系统性变化的主要来源。该网络是通过我们称之为因子调整动态加权移动平均（Factor-Adjusted Dynamic EWMA，简称FADE）的新方法从数据中重建的。随后，一种带符号边的图注意力机制将重建的网络与外生公司特征和宏观经济变量相结合。这种基于图的建模方法旨在生成残差，以更有效地区分资产的特异性均值回归行为和横截面协同运动，为日常统计套利提供具有经济意义的信号。在对2015年至2024年美国日常股票的全面实证研究中，GIDF模型的表现优于传统的因子模型和最先进的深度学习方法，在标准的Avellaneda-Lee规则下实现了1.78的样本外夏普比率。。研究方法：横截面分析、深度学习、因子模型。

papers.title: Platform-Induced Coordination
papers.abstract: This paper studies a platform that influences collective action by selecting which posts each user observes. Each user would like to take an action close to those of the others and to an ideal action determined by her private type and an aggregate state. Posts are non-strategic but correlated with the types of their authors, so each post carries information about the state and its author. We characterise the unique Bayes-Nash equilibrium in closed form. Two explicit networks give the minimum and maximum collective action the platform can induce. Moreover, collective action depends on the network only through the numbers of readers. Hence, many networks induce the same collective action, but they can induce different individual actions. These networks may differ for a regulator, and we compare them by welfare, polarisation and cross-type exposure. In particular, the complete network need not maximise welfare, and the segregated network need not maximise polarisation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文研究了一个通过选择用户可见的帖子来影响集体行为的平台。每个用户都希望采取与他人行为相近的行动，并且这种行为应符合其个人偏好以及由群体整体状态所决定的理想行为。虽然这些帖子本身并不具有策略性，但它们与作者的类型存在关联，因此每篇帖子都蕴含了关于群体状态及其作者的信息。我们以封闭形式描述了该平台所存在的唯一贝叶斯-纳什均衡（Bayes-Nash equilibrium）。通过分析两种特定的网络结构，我们得出了该平台能够引发的集体行为的最大值和最小值。此外，集体行为的形成仅依赖于网络中的读者数量；因此，不同的网络可能会产生相同的集体行为，但导致不同的个体行为。对于监管者而言，这些网络可能存在差异，我们通过福利水平、群体极化程度以及用户之间的互动模式来对它们进行比较。特别需要指出的是，完全整合的网络并不一定能够实现福利的最大化，而分隔的网络也未必会导致极化的加剧。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Time-consistency of cash-subadditive risk measures: The infimal cocycle property
papers.abstract: We characterize the time-consistency of convex, cash-subadditive dynamic risk measures in terms of their minimal penalty. The dual variables are conditional sub-probability densities, which factorize across an intermediate date in many ways, according to how the discount is allocated to the two periods. We introduce an infimal cocycle property, in which the penalty is the infimum over all such factorizations, and show that it is equivalent to time-consistency, with the infimum attained. This holds on $L^\infty$ under continuity from below, and on $L^p$, $p<\infty$, without continuity assumptions. In the cash-additive case it reduces to the classical cocycle property. For risk measures induced by BSDEs, it represents the dynamic programming principle of a stochastic control problem whose value is the penalty.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们通过凸性、现金可加性动态风险度量的最小惩罚值来表征其时间一致性。对偶变量是条件概率密度，它们可以根据折现如何在两个时期之间分配，以多种方式分解为中间日期的函数。我们引入了一个下确界余圈性质（infimal cocycle property），在该性质中，惩罚值是所有这些分解方式下的下确界，并证明这等同于时间一致性，且该下确界确实能够被达到。在$L^\infty$空间中，这一结论在满足下确界连续性假设的情况下成立；而在$L^p$空间（$p<\infty$）中，即使不假设连续性也同样成立。在现金可加性（cash-additive）情况下，这一性质退化为经典的余圈性质。对于由随机微分方程（BSDEs）诱导的风险度量，这一性质体现了随机控制问题的动态规划原理，其中该控制问题的价值即为所对应的惩罚值。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Rank-size analysis of optimal portfolio weights with a reverse-engineering application
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the shape of optimal portfolio weights using rank-size analysis. We consider four portfolio selection models: Global Minimum-Variance (GMV), minimum-CVaR, Risk Parity (RP), and the Most Diversified Portfolio (MDP). For each model, we fit seven rank-size specifications to the sorted portfolio weights generated over rolling windows. To compare the fitted specifications, we combine standard goodness-of-fit measures with Cumulative Second-order $\varepsilon$-Stochastic Dominance, an $\varepsilon$-parameterized generalization of Second-order Stochastic Dominance that quantifies the extent to which the exact dominance conditions are satisfied or violated. Empirically applied to major equity indices, this approach provides a systematic criterion for identifying the optimal functional form across diverse market compositions. Furthermore, we address the inverse problem of identifying the generating model from the observed weight structure. We use the calibrated rank-size parameters as inputs to a Random Forest classifier, evaluated by a blocked cross-validation that accounts for the overlap between estimation windows. The parameters separate minimum-risk from risk-diversification strategies and identify the RP and MDP portfolios, whereas the GMV and minimum-CVaR portfolios are difficult to distinguish. These results indicate that rank-size parameters provide a compact and informative description of portfolio allocation geometries.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文利用秩-大小分析（rank-size analysis）研究了最优投资组合权重的分布特征。我们考察了四种投资组合选择模型：全局最小方差（Global Minimum-Variance, GMV）模型、最小条件风险价值（minimum-CVaR）模型、风险均衡（Risk Parity, RP）模型以及最多样化投资组合（Most Diversified Portfolio, MDP）模型。对于每种模型，我们分别对滚动窗口内生成的排序后的投资组合权重数据拟合了七种不同的秩-大小分布模型。为了比较这些模型的拟合效果，我们结合了传统的拟合优度指标与累积二阶$\varepsilon$-随机优势（Cumulative Second-order $\varepsilon$-Stochastic Dominance）方法——这是一种基于$\varepsilon$参数的二阶随机优势泛化形式，用于量化实际投资组合结构满足或违反最优条件程度的情况。将这种方法应用于主要股票指数后，我们获得了一种系统性的标准，可用于识别不同市场构成下的最优投资组合权重函数形式。此外，我们还探讨了从观测到的投资组合权重结...。研究方法：模型校准、随机森林、随机过程。
